subject: Human Body
title: The Hypothalamus: Command Center
description: A quick win: understand The Hypothalamus: Command Center.

hook.text: A brain region the size of an almond controls hunger, thirst, sleep, and body temperature. It's the hypothalamus.

buildup.text: The hypothalamus sits above the brain stem.

discovery.text: It releases hormones that tell the pituitary gland what to do.

climax.text: The hypothalamus is where brain meets body. It converts thoughts and emotions into physical hormonal responses.

punchline.text: One tiny brain region runs your body's entire hormone network.

quiz.question: How does the hypothalamus control the endocrine system?
options: By sending electrical signals to all glands directly
By releasing hormones that direct the pituitary gland
By filtering blood and removing excess hormones
